title: Unpatched OpenSSL on matchmaking server
description: Outdated OpenSSL build leaves the matchmaking tier exposed to a memory disclosure flaw
compensating_controls: Network segmentation limits reach from the public edge

title: Hard-coded API key in game client build
description: Shipped client binary contains a static service credential that can be extracted by unpacking the build
compensating_controls: Key is scoped to non-production services only

title: Redis cache with no authentication on leaderboard cluster
description: Leaderboard Redis instance accepts unauthenticated commands and is reachable from the public subnet
compensating_controls: Cloud firewall restricts traffic to known game server ranges

title: Player account enumeration via login timing
description: Response timing differs measurably between unknown and known player handles
compensating_controls: Login attempt rate limiting is active

title: Publicly readable object storage bucket holding game telemetry
description: Telemetry export bucket permits anonymous list and read operations
compensating_controls: Bucket policy was restricted to the analytics service principal

title: Outdated Express.js in web storefront
description: Storefront runs a framework release with several known request smuggling fixes missing
compensating_controls: Reverse proxy normalises most malformed request framing

title: Missing MFA for studio administration console
description: Administrative console allows single-factor authentication for accounts with release privileges
compensating_controls: Console is only reachable from the studio VPN

title: TLS 1.0 still enabled on legacy payment endpoint
description: Deprecated protocol version remains negotiable on the older purchase callback listener
compensating_controls: Only one legacy payment partner still connects over this listener

title: SQL injection in player support tool search
description: Unsanitised search parameter reaches a raw query in the support agent console
compensating_controls: Support console access is limited to internal staff

title: Unrestricted file upload in avatar service
description: Avatar upload accepts arbitrary content types and stores files on a web-served path
compensating_controls: Uploaded files are served from a separate origin without cookies

title: Default credentials on Kubernetes dashboard
description: Cluster dashboard was reachable with vendor default administrative credentials
compensating_controls: Dashboard is now bound to the internal management network

title: Unpatched logging library in analytics pipeline
description: Analytics ingestion jobs bundle a logging library affected by a remote code execution flaw
compensating_controls: Jobs run under a restricted service account with no outbound internet

title: Verbose error messages leaking stack traces
description: Application returns full exception traces including internal hostnames to clients
compensating_controls: None

title: Session tokens never expire for game web portal
description: Portal issues non-expiring bearer tokens that survive password changes
compensating_controls: Tokens are bound to a device fingerprint

title: Missing rate limiting on in-game currency purchase API
description: Purchase endpoint permits rapid repeated calls enabling fraudulent grant of premium currency
compensating_controls: Fraud rules flag anomalous purchase velocity after the fact

title: Insecure deserialization in legacy game server RPC
description: Legacy remote procedure call layer deserialises untrusted payloads without type restrictions
compensating_controls: Legacy service is isolated from the public network

title: Anti-cheat telemetry endpoint without authentication
description: Telemetry submission endpoint accepts unsigned reports from any client
compensating_controls: Reports are scored by a heuristic model before influencing bans

title: Weak password policy for player accounts
description: Account system permits short passwords and does not screen against breach corpora
compensating_controls: Breach-password screening is applied at login instead of registration

title: Unencrypted database backups on shared network storage
description: Nightly player database dumps are written to a shared volume without encryption
compensating_controls: Storage volume is on a private subnet with access logging

title: Server-side request forgery in player banner proxy
description: Image proxy fetches arbitrary remote URLs supplied by players
compensating_controls: Outbound fetch is restricted by an allowlist of partner domains

title: Outdated PHP runtime on community forum
description: Forum hosts an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security fixes
compensating_controls: Forum is behind a web application firewall

title: Cross-site scripting in clan chat rendering
description: Chat message body is rendered without adequate output encoding
compensating_controls: Content security policy blocks the majority of injected scripts

title: Exposed version control directory on storefront
description: Deployment left a source control directory readable from the public web root
compensating_controls: Deployment pipeline now excludes metadata directories

title: Missing security headers on account portal
description: Portal omits frame options and transport security policy headers
compensating_controls: None

title: Overly permissive cloud role for build runner
description: Continuous integration runner can assume a role with broad production write access
compensating_controls: Pipeline runs are reviewed before production deploys

title: Anonymous file share on build server
description: Build host exposes a file share that accepts unauthenticated connections
compensating_controls: Host sits on an internal subnet without public routing

title: Unpatched kernel on game server fleet
description: Fleet hosts a kernel release with a local privilege escalation flaw
compensating_controls: Game processes run as an unprivileged account

title: Refund API accepts negative purchase amounts
description: Refund endpoint does not validate the sign of the requested amount
compensating_controls: Manual reconciliation detects the resulting ledger imbalance

title: Matchmaking tokens accepted without signature verification
description: Service trusts the token payload without validating the issuer signature
compensating_controls: Session duration is short for competitive matchmaking

title: Directory listing enabled on asset origin
description: Asset origin server returns directory indexes to unauthenticated callers
compensating_controls: Content delivery layer serves only explicitly referenced paths

title: Outdated plugin on press site
description: Marketing press site runs a plugin release with known stored cross-site scripting flaws
compensating_controls: Site is hosted on separate infrastructure from game services

title: Hard-coded database credentials in container image
description: Published image layer contains plaintext credentials for the player profile database
compensating_controls: Database accepts connections only from the cluster network

title: Missing cross-site request forgery protection on account deletion
description: Destructive account action does not require a token proving user intent
compensating_controls: Deletion triggers a confirmation email with a grace period

title: Predictable password reset tokens
description: Reset tokens are generated from a non-cryptographic source and are guessable
compensating_controls: Tokens are single use and expire after fifteen minutes

title: Unrestricted access to search cluster holding player index
description: Search cluster exposes the player profile index without authentication
compensating_controls: Cluster is reachable only from the internal subnet

title: Deprecated cipher suites on API gateway
description: Gateway still negotiates deprecated ciphers for a subset of legacy clients
compensating_controls: Only non-sensitive catalogue endpoints use the legacy profile

title: Player personal data written to verbose mobile logs
description: Mobile client writes identifiers and partial payment data to device logs
compensating_controls: Logs are sandboxed and not transmitted off device in release builds

title: No integrity verification for downloadable patches
description: Patch packages are applied without verifying a publisher signature
compensating_controls: Downloads are served over transport encryption from a controlled origin

title: Shared service account across production services
description: Multiple unrelated production services authenticate with one long-lived credential
compensating_controls: Account actions are recorded in the central audit trail

title: Missing bot mitigation rules on storefront endpoints
description: Automated scraping of pricing and inventory is not mitigated
compensating_controls: Anomalous traffic is rate limited by the edge provider
